criteria.evidence: One fixed supervised worker owns strict decoding, exact normalization, dependency preparation, finite evaluation, actual and general compilation, fresh replay and exact saved inspection.
Actual advisory backend, sampled process-group peak, whole elapsed time and observed reasons are bound in the run record; required backend unavailable before launch.
Incomplete/cancelled/refused runs have no issued result or completion file, claims, application or process-local event. Saved files do not create live events.

scope_limits: No actual delegated cgroup is available; hard charged-memory/pids enforcement and kernel OOM are conditional implementations, not demonstrated outcomes.
Fixed worker and inherited descendants are trusted code. Process groups are not an arbitrary-code sandbox.
Memory sampling is advisory and elapsed-time enforcement is an operational deadline, not a real-time scheduling guarantee.
Read-only/finalized ownership and independently anchored inherited cache metadata are P07 work.
